info.name: CHP approval ledger (spike)
info.summary: Ledger route L1: the doc commands' checkout / approve / publish requests, with the signed-in identity.
info.description: Task 2 spike (ISO 0.7.0 Plan 1). Takes a request over NextCloud's own HTTPS (OCS), stamps it with the user NextCloud authenticated (never a name from the request), and drops it in /var/lib/chp-docs/spool for the root-owned appender (docs_ledger.py), which owns the hash-chained ledger. The app cannot write the ledger.
